name: Manali
description: Nestled in the Kullu Valley between snow-capped peaks and lush pine forests, Manali is a paradise for adventure lovers and honeymooners alike. From the roaring Beas River to the mystical Rohtang Pass, every corner tells a story of Himalayan grandeur.
travelTips: Book Rohtang Pass permits online in advance
Carry warm clothes even in summer
Try local Himachali cuisine at Old Manali cafés

itinerary.title: Arrival & Old Manali
activities: Arrive in Manali via Volvo bus or flight to Bhuntar
Check into hotel and freshen up
Explore Old Manali's cafés and hippie culture
Visit Hadimba Temple (Dhungri Van Vihar)
Evening stroll along Mall Road

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Adventure
activities: Early morning departure to Solang Valley
Try paragliding or zorbing (seasonal)
Cable car ride to Solang summit
Snow activities and photography
Return for evening at Vashisht Hot Springs

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass Expedition
activities: Start early (6 AM) for Rohtang Pass
Stop at Marhi for breakfast and views
Snow play and photography at Rohtang (3,978m)
Visit Rahala Waterfalls on the way back
Evening bonfire at hotel

itinerary.title: Naggar & Kullu
activities: Visit Naggar Castle and art gallery
Explore Jana Waterfall trek
Afternoon river rafting on Beas River
Visit Kullu shawl factories
Departure or extended stay

name: Shimla
description: Once the summer capital of British India, Shimla enchants visitors with its colonial architecture, winding mountain roads, and panoramic Himalayan views. The iconic Mall Road, toy train, and snow-kissed winters make it a timeless Indian destination.
travelTips: Book Kalka-Shimla toy train tickets well in advance
Mall Road is pedestrian-only – enjoy car-free walks
Visit during December for snowfall experience

itinerary.title: Heritage Walk
activities: Arrive via toy train or road from Chandigarh
Walk the Ridge and Mall Road
Visit Christ Church and Gaiety Theatre
Explore Lakkar Bazaar for wooden crafts
Evening at Scandal Point with mountain views

itinerary.title: Kufri & Nature
activities: Morning trip to Kufri (16 km from Shimla)
Horse riding and yak rides
Visit Himalayan Nature Park
Afternoon at Green Valley viewpoint
Evening shopping at Mall Road

itinerary.title: Temples & Trails
activities: Trek to Jakhoo Temple (Hanuman statue)
Visit Viceregal Lodge (Indian Institute of Advanced Study)
Nature walk at Annandale
Visit Shimla State Museum
Farewell dinner at a heritage restaurant

name: Jaipur
description: Jaipur, the jewel of Rajasthan, dazzles with its pink-hued architecture, magnificent forts, and royal heritage. From the intricate Hawa Mahal to the grandeur of Amber Fort, every monument tells tales of Rajput valor and artistic brilliance.
travelTips: Start early to beat the heat at forts
Hire a local guide at Amber Fort for rich history
Try authentic Rajasthani thali at LMB or Chokhi Dhani

itinerary.title: Royal Forts
activities: Morning visit to Amber Fort with elephant/jeep ride
Explore Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) inside
Stop at Jal Mahal (Water Palace) for photos
Afternoon at Nahargarh Fort for sunset views
Evening at Chokhi Dhani village resort for dinner

itinerary.title: Pink City Heritage
activities: Early morning at Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
Visit City Palace and its museum
Explore Jantar Mantar observatory (UNESCO site)
Shopping at Johari Bazaar for gems and textiles
Evening light & sound show at Amber Fort

itinerary.title: Culture & Crafts
activities: Visit Albert Hall Museum
Explore Birla Mandir temple
Block printing workshop in Sanganer
Afternoon at Jaigarh Fort (cannon collection)
Farewell dinner with Rajasthani folk music

name: Rishikesh
description: Where the Ganges flows through forested Himalayan foothills, Rishikesh offers a unique blend of spiritual serenity and adrenaline-pumping adventure. From yoga ashrams to white-water rafting, this sacred city rejuvenates both body and soul.
travelTips: Attend the Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat at sunset
Book rafting with certified operators only
Rishikesh is a vegetarian and alcohol-free city

itinerary.title: Spiritual Rishikesh
activities: Arrive and check in near Laxman Jhula
Walk across Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula bridges
Visit Trayambakeshwar Temple
Afternoon yoga session at an ashram
Evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat

itinerary.title: Adventure Day
activities: Morning white-water rafting (16-26 km options)
Cliff jumping at designated spots
Lunch at a riverside café
Visit Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
Sunset from Kunjapuri Temple viewpoint

itinerary.title: Nature & Wellness
activities: Sunrise yoga by the Ganges
Trek to Neer Garh Waterfall
Visit Rajaji National Park (seasonal)
Ayurvedic spa treatment
Evening meditation and departure

name: Varanasi
description: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, Varanasi is the spiritual heart of India. The mesmerizing ghats along the Ganges, ancient temples, and the legendary Ganga Aarti create an experience that transcends time itself.
travelTips: Take a dawn boat ride for the most magical experience
Hire a local guide to navigate the narrow lanes
Try the famous Banarasi paan and kachori

itinerary.title: The Sacred Ghats
activities: Arrive and check in near Assi Ghat
Walk along the 84 ghats of Varanasi
Visit Dashashwamedh Ghat
Evening Ganga Aarti ceremony (must-see)
Dinner with a view at a ghat-side restaurant

itinerary.title: Temples & Heritage
activities: Pre-dawn boat ride on the Ganges
Visit Kashi Vishwanath Temple
Explore Banaras Hindu University campus
Afternoon at Ramnagar Fort across the river
Evening walk through the old city lanes

itinerary.title: Sarnath & Silk
activities: Day trip to Sarnath (where Buddha preached)
Visit Dhamek Stupa and Sarnath Museum
Afternoon Banarasi silk sari shopping
Visit Tulsi Manas Temple
Farewell lassi at Blue Lassi Shop

name: Goa
description: India's smallest state packs the biggest punch with its sun-kissed beaches, Portuguese heritage, vibrant nightlife, and laid-back vibe. From the lively shores of North Goa to the serene coves of South Goa, there's a beach for every mood.
travelTips: Rent a scooter for the most authentic Goa experience
South Goa is quieter, North Goa is more lively
Try Goan fish curry, vindaloo, and bebinca

itinerary.title: North Goa Beaches
activities: Arrive and settle into beach hotel/hostel
Hit Baga Beach for water sports
Lunch at a beach shack
Visit Fort Aguada for sunset views
Night out at Tito's Lane, Baga

itinerary.title: Heritage & Culture
activities: Visit Old Goa – Basilica of Bom Jesus (UNESCO)
Explore Se Cathedral and Church of St. Francis
Lunch of authentic Goan cuisine in Panjim
Walk through Latin Quarter of Fontainhas
Evening cruise on Mandovi River

itinerary.title: South Goa Serenity
activities: Drive to Palolem Beach (South Goa)
Kayaking and dolphin spotting
Visit Cabo de Rama Fort
Relax at Cola Beach's hidden lagoon
Seafood dinner at a beach candlelit restaurant

itinerary.title: Adventure & Waterfalls
activities: Full-day trip to Dudhsagar Falls
Jeep ride through Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary
Swim in the waterfall pools
Spice plantation visit on the way back
Farewell beach party

name: Meghalaya
description: Meghalaya, the 'Abode of Clouds,' is a mystical wonderland of living root bridges, crystal-clear rivers, dramatic waterfalls, and the wettest place on Earth. This untouched paradise in Northeast India offers adventures found nowhere else.
travelTips: Carry rain gear – Meghalaya gets heavy rainfall
The root bridge trek requires moderate fitness
Respect Khasi culture and local customs

itinerary.title: Shillong – Capital City
activities: Arrive at Shillong via Guwahati (IXS airport)
Visit Ward's Lake and Lady Hydari Park
Explore Police Bazaar for local food
Visit Don Bosco Museum (NE India culture)
Evening at Café Shillong with live music

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji Waterfalls
activities: Drive to Cherrapunji (Sohra) – 2 hours
Visit Nohkalikai Falls (tallest plunge waterfall in India)
Explore Seven Sisters Falls viewpoint
Visit Mawsmai Cave (limestone formations)
Stay overnight in Cherrapunji

itinerary.title: Living Root Bridges
activities: Trek to Double Decker Living Root Bridge (Nongriat)
3,500 steps descent through rainforest
Swim in natural rock pools
Marvel at the 180-year-old root bridges
Trek back and rest

itinerary.title: Dawki & Bangladesh Border
activities: Drive to Dawki – India-Bangladesh border
Boating on crystal-clear Umngot River
Visit Mawlynnong – Asia's cleanest village
Sky Walk viewpoint over Bangladesh plains
Return to Shillong

itinerary.title: Jaintia Hills
activities: Visit Krang Suri Waterfall (turquoise pools)
Explore Jaintia Hills landscape
Local Khasi cuisine lunch
Shopping for Khasi handicrafts
Departure from Shillong/Guwahati

name: Leh-Ladakh
description: A surreal high-altitude desert where turquoise lakes meet barren mountains, ancient monasteries cling to cliffsides, and the world's highest motorable roads test your limits. Ladakh is the ultimate frontier for adventurers and seekers of raw, untamed beauty.
travelTips: Acclimatize for 1-2 days in Leh before traveling
Get Inner Line Permits for Pangong and Nubra
Carry altitude sickness medication (Diamox)

itinerary.title: Arrival & Acclimatization
activities: Fly into Leh Kushok Bakula Airport
REST – acclimatize to high altitude (3,500m)
Light walk around Leh Market
Visit Shanti Stupa for sunset views
Early dinner and rest

itinerary.title: Leh Exploration
activities: Visit Leh Palace (17th century royal palace)
Explore Namgyal Tsemo Monastery
Drive to Magnetic Hill and Gurudwara Pathar Sahib
Visit Sangam – confluence of Indus and Zanskar
Evening at Leh Market for souvenirs

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley
activities: Cross Khardung La Pass (5,359m – world's highest)
Drive down to Nubra Valley
Double-humped camel ride at Hunder Sand Dunes
Visit Diskit Monastery and giant Buddha statue
Overnight camp under the stars in Nubra

itinerary.title: Pangong Lake
activities: Drive from Nubra to Pangong via Shyok route
Arrive at Pangong Tso – the famous blue lake
Photography at the ever-changing blue waters
Visit the 3 Idiots filming point
Overnight in lakeside camps

itinerary.title: Monasteries & Culture
activities: Return to Leh from Pangong via Chang La
Visit Hemis Monastery (largest in Ladakh)
Explore Thiksey Monastery (mini Potala Palace)
Visit Shey Palace ruins
Farewell dinner with Ladakhi cuisine

name: Kedarnath
description: Perched amidst the majestic snow-clad peaks of the Garhwal Himalayas near the Mandakini River, Kedarnath is one of the most sacred pilgrimage sites in India. Dominated by the ancient 8th-century stone temple, it offers an incomparable spiritual trekking experience.
travelTips: Physical fitness is essential for the 16 km trek from Gauri Kund
Get a mandatory medical check-up at Gauri Kund if needed
Carry heavy woolens and a good raincoat

itinerary.title: Haridwar/Rishikesh to Guptkashi
activities: Drive from Rishikesh/Haridwar to Guptkashi or Sonprayag (200 km, 7-8 hours)
Enjoy panoramic views of Ganga and Alaknanda rivers on the way
Check in at hotel/camp in Guptkashi
Prepare trek gear and rest for the early morning start

itinerary.title: Trek Gauri Kund to Kedarnath
activities: Drive to Sonprayag, then take local shuttle to Gauri Kund
Begin the legendary 16 km steep trek to Kedarnath Temple
Marvel at mountain waterfalls and snow summits along the trek path
Arrive at Kedarnath base camp in the afternoon
Attend the magical evening Shiva Aarti inside the grand stone temple

itinerary.title: Bhairav Temple & Descent
activities: Wake up early (5 AM) for morning Darshan inside the sanctum sanctorum
Trek 1 km further up to Bhairav Nath Temple for a breathtaking view of the valley
Begin the 16 km return trek down to Gauri Kund
Take shuttle back to Sonprayag/Guptkashi for overnight stay

name: Madhya Maheshwar
description: Madhya Maheshwar (Madmaheshwar) is a picturesque mountain hamlet set in a green meadow beneath the snow-crowned Chaukhamba peaks. As the fourth temple of the famous Panch Kedar pilgrimage, it remains blissfully untouched, peaceful, and stunningly scenic.
travelTips: Trek starts from Ransi village — carry cash since network is limited
Budha Madmaheshwar (2 km above temple) offers the best sunrise over Chaukhamba
Homestays are run by warm local villagers — enjoy simple Pahadi hospitality

itinerary.title: Drive to Ukhimath / Ransi
activities: Drive from Rishikesh to Ukhimath / Ransi village (190 km, 7 hours)
Visit Omkareshwar Temple in Ukhimath (winter seat of Kedarnath)
Continue to Ransi village and check into local homestay
Enjoy organic local dinner and prepare for trekking

itinerary.title: Trek Ransi to Madmaheshwar
activities: Start the scenic 16 km forest trek along the Madmaheshwar Ganga
Pass through dense bamboo and rhododendron groves and villages like Gaundhar
After a steep final climb, arrive at the beautiful meadows of Madmaheshwar
Check into temple guest rooms or local huts
Attend evening prayers at the historic stone temple

itinerary.title: Budha Madmaheshwar & Descent
activities: Wake up at 4 AM to climb 2 km up to Budha Madmaheshwar ridge
Witness the spectacular gold reflection of sunrise on Chaukhamba Peaks
Descend to temple for breakfast
Trek back 16 km down to Ransi village
Drive back to Ukhimath for rest and overnight stay

name: Dharamshala
description: Fringed by gorgeous pine and deodar forests and set against the towering, snow-covered Dhauladhar mountain range, Dharamshala is a vibrant multicultural destination. McLeod Ganj serves as the headquarters of the Tibetan Government in Exile.
travelTips: Stay in McLeod Ganj or Dharamkot for easy café and temple access
Triund trek is easy-moderate but requires pre-booking for overnight camps
Try hot momos, thukpa, and butter tea at Tibetan stalls

itinerary.title: Tibetan Culture & McLeod Ganj
activities: Arrive in Dharamshala (Kangra airport or Volvo bus)
Check in at hotel in McLeod Ganj
Visit Tsuglagkhang Complex (Dalai Lama Temple)
Explore the Tibetan Museum and spin the prayer wheels
Evening stroll around the McLeod Ganj markets and cafés

itinerary.title: Triund Trek Adventure
activities: Start early from McLeod Ganj / Gallu Devi Temple
Begin the scenic 9 km pine-forest trek to Triund
Pass Magic View café and enjoy views of Kangra Valley
Arrive at Triund Ridge (2,875m) directly beneath the Dhauladhar wall
Overnight camping, dinner, and stargazing under the peaks

itinerary.title: Bhagsunag & HPCA Stadium
activities: Witness the sunrise over the peaks, then trek down to McLeod Ganj
Visit Bhagsunag Temple and the Bhagsu waterfall
Relax at Shiva Café in Bhagsu
Drive down to Lower Dharamshala to visit the stunning HPCA Cricket Stadium
Explore the War Memorial or Kotwali Bazaar

name: Ujjain
description: Ujjain, one of the oldest cities in India, sits majestically on the banks of the sacred Shipra River. Renowned for the legendary Mahakaleshwar temple, a self-manifested Jyotirlinga, the city vibrates with intense spiritual energy, colorful river aartis, and rich historic heritage.
travelTips: Book your Bhasma Aarti online weeks in advance at Mahakaleshwar Temple
Take a holy dip and attend the evening Shipra River Aarti at Ram Ghat
Kal Bhairav Temple accepts traditional liquor offerings as Prasad

itinerary.title: Spiritual Awakening
activities: Arrive in Ujjain via flight to Indore (IDR) or train
Check into a heritage hotel or central dharmashala
Visit Harsiddhi Temple (one of the 51 Shaktipeethas)
Witness the grand evening Shipra River Aarti at Ram Ghat
Explore local markets for ethnic Malwa crafts

itinerary.title: Mahakal Temple & Antiquities
activities: Early morning Bhasma Aarti (optional/pre-booked) at Mahakaleshwar Temple
Visit the unique Kal Bhairav Temple
Explore the ancient observatory Vedh Shala (Jantar Mantar)
Visit Sandipani Ashram (where Lord Krishna studied)
Savor local street foods like Poha-Jalebi and Dal Bafla
